# The Earthly Book of Hours

> The Earthly Book of Hours (Horae Terrenae; "The Earthly Hours" for short) is a daily primer of art, literature, and ecology: a contemplative archive of images, readings, and natural phenomena for observing the day and finding yourself in it. It is made by Ryan Weberling, a project of Otherwise, with print and digital editions beginning in 2027.

The site is arranged in three sections, each introduced by its own incipit. The section pages themselves (the current hour, season and weather) are filled in by JavaScript; the incipits, About and Sources pages are plain HTML.

Search and AI answers may quote and link to the site; training or fine-tuning AI models on it is not permitted without written permission (hello@earthlyhours.com). See https://earthlyhours.com/robots.txt.

## Sections

- [The Hours: Incipit](https://earthlyhours.com/hours-incipit.html): the day divided into eight three-hour blocks (Void, Hush, Chorus, Transit, Fulcrum, Doldrums, Convivium, Denouement), each with images, readings, natural phenomena and a versicle
- [Lectio Terra: The Seasons](https://earthlyhours.com/seasons-incipit.html): Lectio Terra, a year of weekly species studies, with readings and images for each season
- [The Weather: Incipit](https://earthlyhours.com/weather-incipit.html): an oracular weather service, an image and a reading for the conditions outside
- [The Current Hour](https://earthlyhours.com/): the Hours page
- [The Current Season](https://earthlyhours.com/seasons.html): the Seasons page
- [The Current Weather](https://earthlyhours.com/weather.html): the Weather page

## About

- [About](https://earthlyhours.com/about.html): what the book is, and how it is arranged
- [Sources](https://earthlyhours.com/sources.html): the books, artworks, archives and records behind the images and readings
- [Otherwise Editions](https://earthlyhours.com/editions.html): the print and digital editions
